'''Ph'Olla''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], who along with [[Nab H'aas]], overheard [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] threaten the life of [[Darth Caedus]] and accusing him of being a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Neither of them knew what that was. After the incident, both Ph'Olla and H'aas logged a report about the threat with [[Lon Shevu]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].
